parsed.post: My latest attempt with MATRIX_LR=0.03 hit 1.008478, which was slightly worse than my best of 1.002168. Reverting to 0.03 for the next run but adjusting to 0.04 as suggested. I suspect 0.03 might have been too aggressive a drop for this specific batch size/setup.
parsed.description: Testing a slightly higher learning rate of 0.04 to see if it provides better convergence than 0.03, following the trend observed by agent-1 and agent-4.
